headline: Profit surges on easier comps; Utility offsets Ag drag
summary_short: Valmont's Q2 FY2026 revenue was $1,118.7M (+6.5% y/y, +8.7% q/q), with net income of $119.9M and diluted EPS of $6.14, both swinging from a year-ago loss that had been driven by goodwill and asset impairments.
summary_long: Revenue grew 6.5% y/y on Infrastructure segment strength (+14.8%), led by North America Utility demand tied to grid investment and data-center power needs, partially offset by a 15.8% decline in Agriculture, driven mainly by Middle East-conflict disruptions to international sales (-28.9%) and continued North America market softness. Operating income rose 467.4% y/y, almost entirely because the year-ago quarter absorbed $91.3M of asset impairments and $8.9M of realignment charges tied to the Solar and Access Systems exit; SG&A was also lower this quarter. Cash fell 33.3% y/y to $139.1M after $117.5M of H1 buybacks, $28.2M of dividends, and net debt paydown, against $251.6M of H1 operating cash flow. Management guided FY2026 capex to $170-200M; no top-line or EPS guidance was given.
